policy: two-tier lexicon (bead hearsay-four-1c9--mfcc-viterbi-speed.1--oov-fallback-policy). Tier-1 CMUdict content wins every word it covers; tier-2 librispeech-lexicon fills only words tier-1 lacks. Every entry carries source=cmudict|librispeech-g2p (lexicon::LexiconSource).

tier1.path: ../better-voice/data/phonetics/Master_English_Phonetics_FINAL_COMPLETE.txt (repo-relative from checkout root; override with BETTER_VOICE_ROOT env)
tier1.format: lowercase word<TAB>PHONES<TAB>tag rows, # comments, CRLF; converted by lexicon::master_tsv_to_cmudict

tier2.path: data/lexicon/librispeech-lexicon.txt (gitignored derived data; download with the URL above and verify sha256)
tier2.format: WORD<space|tab>PHONES with stress digits (Sequitur classical statistical G2P extended); parsed by lexicon::parse_cmudict_line_with_source

tier3.path: ~/hearsay-personal/owner-book-g2p.txt (personal data, outside the repo; override with OWNER_BOOK_G2P env)
tier3.format: WORD<2 spaces>PHONES, stress-stripped ARPABET from lexicon::rule_g2p (RULE_ENGINE_ID lexicon-rules-v1); ;;; header lines; parsed by lexicon::parse_cmudict_line_with_source
tier3.gate: cargo run --release -p hmm --example r2_perf -- wordlist-scan ~/hearsay-personal/owner-book.stripped.txt => wordscan_missing_types=0 wordscan_missing_tokens=0 wordscan_tier3_types=180 wordscan_tier3_tokens=278

census_measured_2026_10_31.tool: cargo run --release -p hmm --example r2_perf -- <manifest> <wav_root> 9999 1 lexscan (BETTER_VOICE_ROOT set; exact R2 scan logic, two-tier load)

decoder_lm_vocab_dev_oov: same merged table: token OOV 871/54402 (1.60%, 675 types) -> 163/54402 (0.30%, 97 types)
book_census_counts_only: wordlist-scan over owner-book.stripped.txt (lm::normalize, 7559 sents / 105191 tokens): 8294 word types; tier1 7782 types / 103309 tokens; tier2 332 types / 1549 tokens; missing-from-both 180 types / 278 tokens (55 <num> tokens excluded from word counts). Recipe: cargo run --release -p hmm --example r2_perf -- wordlist-scan <stripped.txt> <tier1.tsv> <tier2.txt>
